verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Gemini CLI can run non-interactively in scripts and power automated PR review and issue triage, but none of it documents a way to schedule recurring jobs. Non-interactive scripting is only a building block that a user could pair with an external scheduler such as cron, and the PR/issue automations are event-driven or on-demand rather than recurring schedules. Neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
